exact_model_contract.rule: Copy the frozen P4 engineering model structure and canonical movement values exactly; change only field.sigma_field_mm, steering.kappa_trail_per_s, absolute_detection.theta_detect, model id/title/status/provenance fields needed to identify the frozen fitted execution model. No runtime code change is authorized.

exact_apparatus_contract.rule: Derived left/right apparatus files must preserve every base world/geometry/boundary/entry/terminal value and differ only by addition of the exact painted_trail external field with the authorized side-specific arm-centerline segment plus metadata/provenance.

exact_experiment_contract.rule: Left/right experiments differ only in apparatus id/marked-side metadata. Neutral uses exact zero-dose P4 identity on one derived apparatus or equivalent base geometry while preserving the same initialization/scoring contract. No biological condition-specific parameterization is allowed.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: any derivative Y-maze biological outcome target

required_synthetic_checks: all six predeclared overall/condition/side comparison rows are emitted
signed difference equals model minus observed
absolute difference equals absolute signed difference
no inferential p-value or significance label

reference_free_qualification.purpose: Verify implementation wiring, symmetry/side reversal, exact zero-dose identity, deterministic reproducibility, endpoint accounting, Stage-A outcome firewall, and Node/Chromium parity without using official seeds or biological Y-maze outcomes.
required_checks: fitted model differs from frozen P4 engineering model only in authorized identity/provenance fields and candidate-307 sigma/kappa/theta
derived apparatus preserve base geometry exactly and add only the authorized field segment
left/right experiments preserve frozen initialization/scoring/dose contract
Stage-A runner source contains no import/path/read of known biological Y-maze summary artifacts
zero-dose fitted P4 trajectory/fingerprint preserves canonical identity under same seed
same-seed left/right marked conditions are deterministic
side reversal maps the field to the opposite arm without changing runtime biology
all choices/timeouts sum to requested trial counts
Wilson interval implementation is finite and bounded
Stage-B comparator synthetic fixture emits every required comparison and no decision semantics
real Chromium parity passes on at least 6 non-official seeds spanning left-marked, right-marked, and zero-dose neutral cases
Chromium/network audit makes zero requests for known biological Y-maze outcome artifacts

next_gate.purpose: Implement only the authorized surface and produce a permanent reference-free qualification report with full code/regression and Chromium parity evidence. A later explicit execution gate is required before official Stage A seeds may run.
